system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: injects the patient profile and current datetime as structured context
system_prompt_style.note: Assistant prompt file not in evidence; user-agent prompt uses format_prompt_safe with variables. Tool descriptions appended.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: On each turn, the agent receives the full conversation history and the patient profile, reasons about the appropriate next action, and may invoke one or more sandbox tools
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a healthcare sandbox, not a repo; profile injected up front plus tools like get_profile/list_doctors. Closest-value mapping.

context_compaction.note: Assistant agent source not in evidence bundle; thinking-content stripping applies only to messages passed to user agent.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
the assistant is a LangGraph ReAct
agent that reasons and acts against the healthcare sandbox
tool_call_format.note: LangGraph ReAct agent inferred to use provider tool-calling; parser not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool definition code not in evidence.

Conversations that encounter unrecoverable
agent errors are terminated with an error marker and excluded from aggregate scoring.
